name: sovereign-critters
description: Claude Code mods from Sovereign Matrix: a wizard critter and an orange cat, a build bell, a session diary, a crab that holds your place, and a few small mods that show what a mod can do.

plugins.name: critter-buddy
plugins.description: The wizard, the cat, a stage, names, a cast chime and a purr, a diary the model can read, and a Day and Night backdrop.

plugins.name: critter-mods
plugins.description: /mods: the control room. One pane lists every mod, switches each on or off, installs the missing ones, and opens each mod's own panes.

plugins.name: critter-bell
plugins.description: A counter-bell strike and a toast when a long command or a long turn finishes.

plugins.name: critter-diary
plugins.description: /diary: every tool call with its time, a line for each turn, and a copy-as-markdown button. Names and times only.

plugins.name: critter-measure
plugins.description: A tool that counts text exactly: characters, words, lines and UTF-8 bytes.

plugins.name: critter-stunt
plugins.description: /stunt: the critter painted in a pane, with a card for each of the last 40 tool calls.

plugins.name: critter-crab
plugins.description: /crab hold <text>: a small crab carries a note for this folder, and has it for you when you come back.

plugins.name: critter-ward
plugins.description: Stops a git push that forces or writes main or master, before Bash runs it. Best effort.

plugins.name: critter-tally
plugins.description: /everywhere: a pane of your three most-used tools, drawn by each app its own way.

plugins.name: critter-clock
plugins.description: /clock: how long the session has run and how much of it Claude spent working. Times only.

plugins.name: critter-ledger
plugins.description: /ledger: tokens used this session, with a limit of your own. Silent until you ask.

plugins.name: critter-latch
plugins.description: Opt-in: stops recursive deletes outside your folder, git reset --hard, git clean -f and checkout over the whole tree.

plugins.name: critter-seal
plugins.description: Opt-in: holds back a command that sends a secret to a host you have not listed.
